issues: No integrity problems: the diff only restructures the SLSQP polish into up to 5 chunks of 60 iterations (same 300-iteration cap) and adds an early abort when the LP radii sum is more than 0.03 below the best so far. It uses no file or network access, no pasted coordinates and no clock.
Validity is unchanged: centers are still clipped to [0, 1] and the radii still come from _lp_radii.
Minor: restarting SLSQP every 60 iterations throws away the curvature information it has built up, which may make the polish weaker. This is a quality concern, not a correctness bug.
